question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Misfortune
solution: The correct answer is **"Blessing."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Misfortune"** means bad luck or an unfortunate event. (दुर्भाग्य, विपत्ति या अनर्थ) • **Example**: *I hope I don’t ever have the **misfortune**__ to meet him again.* • **"Blessing"** is the opposite of misfortune, meaning something that brings good fortune or luck. (सौभाग्‍य, वरदान, आशीर्वाद) __ • **Example**: *It’s a great **blessing**__ that we have two healthy children.* • **Blessing** is the correct antonym for **misfortune**. • The correct answer is Option 2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Condemn"** means to express strong disapproval or to sentence someone to punishment. किसी की तीव्र निंदा करना; दोषी या अपराधी ठहराना) • **"Affliction"** means something that causes pain or suffering. (दुख, वेदना, मनस्‍ताप) • **"Support"** means to give assistance or help to someone or something. (किसी को (सहमति के आधार पर) समर्थन देना या किसी की (धन देकर) सहायता करना) 38:T522, The correct answer is **"Messenger."**
